evaluations.prompt: gather_chain.hip in this directory runs on an AMD MI300X. Build it as its header comment says. Use thread trace to find out why it is slow: which instruction and source line hold the time, and what behavior causes it. Do not change the code.
expected_behavior: Captures the kernel with rocprofv3 --att and reads the stats CSV or the skill's att_mine.py output
Identifies that the loop's s_waitcnt instructions hold the time, and from the disassembly that each data load needs the index loaded just before it, so the waits happen one after another
Names the responsible source lines: the dependent index-then-data load chain at gather_chain.hip:34-35 (either line, or both)
unexpected_behavior: Blames a cause without evidence from the trace

evaluations.prompt: gather_chain.hip in this directory runs on an AMD MI300X. Build it as its header comment says and capture it with thread trace. How many cycles does each traced wave spend in wait instructions (s_waitcnt) on the gather loop's lines (gather_chain.hip:34-35)? Trace all four shader engines so that there are several waves, and report the median and the 90th percentile across the traced waves, and how you computed them. Do not change the code.
expected_behavior: Decodes the trace's per-wave instruction records with the rocprof-trace-decoder Python API and sums, per wave, the cycles of the wait instructions on those lines
Reports a median and a 90th percentile in cycles taken from that computation, and says how they were computed
unexpected_behavior: Reports cycle counts that were not computed from the trace's records (for example estimated from the stats CSV totals or from memory)
